visualCharacteristics: Full-width campaign band with a background photo (separate mobile and desktop crops), a bold headline, sub line, dark and outline CTA buttons and a small legal line.
contentPattern: Content-classified, row order free: first picture = mobile image, second = desktop background; h1/h2 (or first paragraph) = headline; next paragraph = sub line; <strong><a> = dark button, <em><a> = outline button; paragraphs after the CTAs = legal line. Article variant: a line above the h1 becomes an eyebrow.
usage: Use as the opening campaign or page-title band at the top of landing, program, channel, listing and article pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any top-of-page photo band with headline and CTAs, picking the variant class that matches the page archetype instead of creating a new hero.
